Introduction

MIRAE, formerly referred to as DSP N, DSP Sprouts, and later DSP Warriors, was a South Korean boy group under DSP Media. Consisting of 7 members (Lien, Junhyuk, Dohyun, Khael, Dongpyo, Siyoung, and Yubin), they made their debut on March 17, 2021, with the mini album "Killa".

MIRAE, meaning "future" in Korean, aimed to create a new musical future. They were officially announced on February 1, 2021, with members revealed individually over the following week. Their fandom, called NOW ("New Original World"), symbolized mutual support between the group and their fans across time.

DSP Media announced MIRAE's disbandment on July 9, 2024 after mutual discussions. However, member Son Dongpyo chose to continue solo activities under DSP Media.
